title: When Does Feedback Help? Auditing Learned Voltage-Clamp Experimental Design
abstract: arXiv:2610.27632v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A learned scientific controller can outperform a misspecified planner without benefiting from feedback. We audit two synthetic voltage-clamp tasks with a training-selected fixed protocol, current masking, a Bayesian reference, and an excluded target. Five recurrent policies repeat one fixed protocol in all 1,200 off-grid rollouts; masking current changes no decision. In a crossed four-hypothesis task, a fixed diagnostic pulse is followed by one learned choice. Policies then use the first current, but tie a correctly specified Bayesian controller, and a fitted threshold reproduces the learned actions without being that controller. The excluded-target prediction gain is $4.6991\times10^{-6}$ nats per sample. Feedback use and protocol quality are separate tests. These cases establish neither biological discovery nor general RL superiority.

translated_title: 反馈何时有用？审计学习型电压钳实验设计
translated_abstract: 一个学习型科学控制器可以在不从反馈中获益的情况下超越设定错误的规划器。我们审计了两个合成电压钳任务，这些任务包含训练选择的固定协议、电流掩蔽、贝叶斯参考控制器以及被排除的目标。五个循环策略在全部1,200次离网格 rollout 中重复同一个固定协议；掩蔽电流不会改变任何决策。在一个交叉四假设任务中，固定的诊断脉冲之后跟随一个由策略学习得到的选择。策略随后使用了第一次电流，但与正确设定的贝叶斯控制器表现持平，而且一个拟合的阈值模型能够在并非该贝叶斯控制器的情况下复现策略学到的动作。被排除目标的预测增益为每样本 $4.6991\times10^{-6}$ nats。反馈的使用与协议的质量是两个独立的测试。这些案例既不构成生物学发现，也不证明强化学习的普遍优越性。
tldr: 本文审计学习型电压钳实验设计策略后发现，策略在所有测试中重复固定协议、对反馈（如电流掩蔽）完全不敏感，且仅与正确设定的贝叶斯控制器持平，表明反馈收益与协议质量必须作为独立指标分开评估。
en_tdlr: Audits of learned voltage-clamp experimental design policies reveal that the policies repeat a fixed protocol across all tests, are insensitive to feedback such as current masking, and only tie a correctly specified Bayesian controller, demonstrating that feedback benefit and protocol quality must be evaluated as separate tests.
